name: code-editor
title: Code Editor
description: A headless-ish CodeMirror 6 code editor whose language, theme, extensions, read-only state, placeholder, and completion are consumer-injected through compartments and reconfigure live, with an optional token-aware theme and syntax colors bound to design-system CSS variables, an autocompletion config pass-through, a content-DOM id for a11y, and a double-click guard that stops a dictionary extension's definition popup while preserving word-select.
